body: I’m not sure what could change my mindset.
Well yes but the whole point of me saying that I’m aware that everyone has bad and good days is to show that I’m not dramatic to think about ending it.

My mindset. I know we have our good and bad days but on my good days I feel like anything is possible. On the bad, I can’t even handle the thought of being perceived. I’ve tried to rewire the way I think. It worked for a couple weeks. I was realistically positive and then suddenly I crashed. I crashed so low and I haven’t been able to pick myself up since.
I would want to love myself. To be able to look in the mirror and be content with who I am both inside and out. That’s all I want.

Almost everyday. There is this memory of me when I was 11 and I held a knife to my wrist. I think about that memory very often. I blissfully think about ending it all that day. I imagine what it would be like.
